is_being_held.description: Tests if one or more buttons are being held.
is_being_held.name: Button is being held

held.description: Triggers when one or more buttons are held, optionally repeating at a set interval for as long as they stay held.

interval.description: How often to trigger again while the button stays held. Leave empty to trigger once per hold.
interval.name: Interval

held.name: Button held

pressed.description: Triggers when one or more buttons are pressed.
pressed.name: Button pressed
